title: The Morning Digest: November 13, 2026
dek: Brent Jan27 settled at $95.82 on Thursday, up about $3.06 or 3.3 percent, and WTI Dec26 settled at $88.74, up $2.21 or 2.6 percent (Bloomberg via Rigzone, Nov 12), taking the Brent to WTI spread to $7.08, and by 0741 GMT Friday Brent was $96.04 and WTI $88.59 (Reuters, Nov 13). The inventory report for the week ending Nov 6 printed crude up 4.657 million barrels, gasoline up 1.8 million and distillate up 4.1 million, builds on every major line against surveys that expected draws. December WCS is -$28.36 (ICE TMW settle, Nov 12) on zero lots, a sixth straight session without a trade, while the deferred strip widened on 345 to 480 lots a tenor. The validated diesel crack is $92.32.
